meta.name: coding-agent
meta.description: Delegate coding tasks to Codex, Claude Code, or Pi agents via background process. Use when: (1) building/creating new features or apps, (2) reviewing PRs (spawn in temp dir), (3) refactoring large codebases, (4) iterative coding that needs file exploration. NOT for: simple one-liner fixes (just edit), reading code (use read tool), thread-bound ACP harness requests in chat (for example spawn/run Codex or Claude Code in a Discord thread; use sessions_spawn with runtime:"acp"), or any work in ~/clawd workspace (never spawn agents here). Claude Code: use --print --permission-mode bypassPermissions (no PTY). Codex/Pi/OpenCode: pty:true required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在后台进程中委托编码任务给 AI 代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在后台并行运行多个 AI 编码代理
copy.tagline_en: Delegate coding tasks to AI agents in background processes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple AI coding agents in parallel in the background

howto.what: 装上后，当有编码任务时，Claude会启动后台进程，调用Codex、Claude Code或Pi等编码代理来执行，而不是自己手动写代码。它会监控进度并在完成后通知你。
howto.when: 当你提出构建新功能、审查PR、重构代码库或迭代编码等需要探索文件的任务时，技能自动触发。避免用于简单单行修复或阅读代码。
howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude delegates coding tasks to background agents like Codex, Claude Code, or Pi instead of writing code directly. It monitors progress and notifies you on completion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request building new features, reviewing PRs, refactoring, or iterative coding that needs file exploration. Not for simple one-liner fixes or reading code.
